sources.title: The AA — Putting the wrong fuel in your car (misfuelling advice)

intro.narration: This is a thirty-second test of a new, narration-synced animation engine. Watch the camera follow the fuel itself, part by part, exactly as each one is named.

scenes.narration: Watch what the diesel actually does, because it does not stay in the tank. The fuel pump pushes it through the whole system. It flows out of the tank, then through the lift pump, onward through the fuel filter, up into the high-pressure rail, and finally to the injectors that spray it into each cylinder. Every part it reaches gets coated in an oily film. The spark plugs foul, the filter clogs, and the fine injector nozzles gum up with residue, which is why the real fix is draining and flushing the entire line, not just emptying the tank.

outro.narration: If that felt alive, like the picture was telling the story instead of just sitting there, that is the upgrade. Subscribe, and I will rebuild the full videos this way.
